title: Nenu Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Solillada Saradara
desc: Krishna, a ferry driver, is about to marry Rukmini, the love of his life. However, things take a turn when a landlord's daughter falls for him.

title: Readymade Ganda
desc: A woman is determined to keep her assets from falling into the wrong hands. To protect her inheritance, she hires a fake husband.

title: Kavacha
desc: Jayarama, who is visually challenged, agrees to be the guardian of a young girl, Nandini, after her father is murdered. Soon, he finds himself battling a serial killer whose new target is Nandini.

title: Brave Man
desc: An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.

title: Kannad Gothilla
desc: A senior crime inspector investigates a complex case of people going missing in Bengaluru, taking every measure possible to uncover the truth.

title: Dayavittu Gamanisi
desc: Four people from different fields embark on an unusual self-discovery journey, only to find their paths unexpectedly converging near the end, uniting them in transformation.
